name: AEAT_8800_Q24
description: Broadcom AEAT-8800-Q24 10- to 16-bit programmable angular magnetic encoder IC: on-axis Hall sensor reading a diametric two-pole magnet, 3-wire SSI (or SPI) absolute output, ABI incremental and UVW/PWM outputs, 3.3 V or 5 V operation, QFN-24 5 x 5 mm. Remote worm-shaft absolute sensor of the Serenity-UAV nacelle-tilt build (builds/6s/10A/BRUSHED_CAN_485_isolation/): the sensor sits OFF-BOARD in the brake guide on a short cable; the controller board carries only its keyed header. This symbol exists for the sensor daughter board.
verification: VERIFIED -- full 24-pin map read directly from the local copy of [64] (Broadcom pub-005892, 2017-05-17), 'Pin Assignment' / 'Pinout Description' table: 1-6 No connection; 7 I; 8 B; 9 A; 10 SSI_SCL_SPI_CLK; 11 SSI_NSL_SPI_DI; 12 SSI_DO_SPI_DO; 13 VSS; 14 VDDA; 15-18 No connection; 19 VDDA; 20 VSS; 21 SSI_SPI_SEL; 22 U; 23 V; 24 W/PWM; 25 VSS (the exposed pad). Pin electrical types: SSI_SCL_SPI_CLK, SSI_NSL_SPI_DI, SSI_SPI_SEL -> input; SSI_DO_SPI_DO, A, B, I, U, V, W/PWM -> output; VDDA -> power_in; VSS -> power_in; NC -> no_connect. Pin 25 (exposed pad, VSS) is intentionally NOT a symbol pin (repo convention) -- tie the footprint's EP to VSS copper at layout. Device facts VERIFIED from [64] p.1 and 'Recommended Operating Conditions': 3.3 V operation 3.0-3.6 V, SSI 3-wire absolute output, 10/12/14/16-bit resolution, QFN-24 5 x 5 mm. FOOTPRINT: KiCad 9 stock Package_DFN_QFN:QFN-24-1EP_5x5mm_P0.65mm_EP3.25x3.25mm, CHECKED against [64] Figure 16 '24 QFN Dimensions' table: D = E = 5.000 BSC, e = 0.650 BSC, D2 = E2 = 3.200-3.300 (3.250 nom), b = 0.250-0.350, L = 0.350-0.450, A = 0.900 max -- body, pitch, lead width, lead length and exposed pad all match the stock footprint's name and pad geometry. The stock footprint's fillets are an IPC derivation (its descr cites an unrelated Semtech part); [64] Figure 17 'Recommended PCB Land Pattern' is a raster figure whose numbers could not be extracted this session, so the land was NOT verified against Broadcom's own pattern -- flagged per AGENTS.md Sec. 4 (TODO.md 18.5).
